intent: Sustained forward trot at 0.1 m/s on Sesame's 8-joint vertical-axis hips: diagonal pairs A=(RF,LR) and B=(RR,LF) offset by half a cycle, cosine hip sweep with mirrored signs, sine-arch swing knee lift, constant base height and zero rpy.

phases.name: pairA_stance_pairB_swing
phases.base_motion: Constant forward x=home['speed']*t, y=0, z=0.04673357 m, zero roll/pitch/yaw.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A (RF,LR) in stance: hips sweep from +A toward -A about center; knees hold stance flexion 0.15 rad (R3=L4=pi-0.15). Pair B (RR,LF) in swing: hips sweep mirrored, knees lift with sine arch up to 0.55 rad (R4=L3=0.15+0.55*sin(pi*s)).

phases.name: pairB_stance_pairA_swing
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation, constant height, zero attitude.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B (RR,LF) in stance with knees at 0.15 rad; pair A (RF,LR) in swing with sine-arch knee lift up to 0.55 rad. Hip cosine continues smoothly across the wrap.

coding_notes: Parameters: freq=2.55 Hz, hip amplitude A=0.275 rad, hip center=1.625 rad, stance knee flexion=0.15 rad, swing knee lift=0.55 rad, phase0=0.13, base_z=0.04673357 m. pA=frac(freq*t+phase0); pB=frac(pA+0.5). cA=cos(2*pi*pA), cB=cos(2*pi*pB). R1=center+A*cA; R2=pi-center+A*cB; L1=pi-center-A*cB; L2=center-A*cA. Swing flags pA>=0.5, pB>=0.5; sA=(pA-0.5)*2, sB=(pB-0.5)*2; archA=sin(pi*sA), archB=sin(pi*sB); flexA=where(swingA,0.15+0.55*archA,0.15); flexB=where(swingB,0.15+0.55*archB,0.15). R3=pi-flexA, L4=pi-flexA, R4=flexB, L3=flexB. q=stack([R1,R3,R2,R4,L1,L3,L2,L4],dim=-1). root_pos_w=stack([home['speed']*t, 0*t, base_z*(1+0*t)],dim=-1); root_rpy=stack([0*t,0*t,0*t],dim=-1). contacts=stack([pA<0.5, pB<0.5, pB<0.5, pA<0.5],dim=-1). No clipping, projection, or base ripple; swing sine normalized to 0..1 before sine to avoid wrap discontinuity.
